Looking forward to it, Isabella. Have a great rest of your day and let me know if you need anything else.

Thanks again, Carmen. I'll make sure to send that email today and include all our collaboration ideas. Can't wait for Wednesday!

Sounds good, Isabella. I'll keep an eye out for supplies that might be useful for your Valentine’s Day event at Hobbs Cafe.

Thanks, Carmen. I'll send that email later today and let you know if we need any special supplies from your store.
Carmen Ortiz
That would be great, Isabella. Let me know if you need any help or have questions about supplies before Wednesday.
Isabella Rodriguez
Thanks, Carmen. I appreciate your support and flexibility. I'll draft the email later today and include all our discussion points.
